about: A SKILL.md per case and the tool lists a reader must take from it: `declared` is its allowed-tools read verbatim, inline or as a YAML block list, `headless` what a non-interactive run is granted, and `mcp` / `programmatic`, where a case has them, its mcp-tools and programmatic-tools. internal/skillrender (splitFrontmatter, splitTools, FilterHeadlessTools) and the SDK (skillAllowedTools.ts) both read this file (#2358).
